dictionary.Commencez avec une seule intention, puis: Start with a single intention, then change one field at a time. If the subject gets lost, simplify the setting or bring the framing closer. If the style lacks consistency, remove contradictory adjectives. For a series, keep the style, light and palette fields, then vary the pose or action.
dictionary.Commencez par choisir votre quantité, de: Start by choosing your quantity, from 1 to 100 images. The package of €22.90 remains the same on this beach. Then select the format suited to the intended use: a portrait gives space to a silhouette, while a landscape leaves more space for the environment.
dictionary.Commencez par trois éléments : le sujet,: Start with three elements: the subject, the atmosphere and the use. A portrait intended for a small vignette needs a readable face. An image to present a collection can give more space to the garment or decor. This hierarchy helps to choose the right universe before launching variations.
dictionary.Commencez par une situation photographia: Start with a photographable situation. Describe the subject, what it is doing, the light and the location of the setting. A precise material brings more than an accumulation of words like “perfect” or “ultra realistic”.
